# uem_smart_groups (Data Source)

Searches for smart groups in Workspace ONE UEM. Use this data source to look up smart group IDs for profile assignment.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Filter smart groups by name (substring match)
- `organization_group_id` (String) Filter smart groups by organization group ID

### Read-Only

- `smart_groups` (Attributes List) List of smart groups matching the filter criteria (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--smart_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--smart_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `smart_groups`

Read-Only:

- `managed_by_org_group_name` (String) Name of the organization group that manages this smart group
- `name` (String) Smart group name
- `smart_group_id` (Number) Smart group identifier
- `smart_group_uuid` (String) Smart group UUID
